findings.text: follow-on: the done-when requires the seven named ambix test modules to add no failures, but this module (with tests/data/test_transform_engine.py:30 and tests/test_cocos.py:20) errors at collection at the head because out-of-scope importers imas_ambix/gs/geometry.py:21 and imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:28 still import the moved modules, so three of the seven named modules are left unmeasured.

follow-on: the after_suite command is recorded with literal `<wt>` placeholder text in its PYTHONPATH instead of absolute paths, so the recorded gate command cannot be re-run as written to reconcile the count.

follow-on: the module docstring points at `imas_alambic.paths.JT60SA_ROOT`, but the engine ships no `paths` module -- store roots are owned by imas_ambix.data.paths and reached through the bundle -- so the cross-reference resolves nowhere.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against f1f0a5b0; the substantive change is the new MapBundle/load_bundle_descriptor/discover_bundles/bundle_for_machine/resolve_description_store_root block in machine_map.py, the entry-point target imas_ambix/data/bundle.py, the nova_cocos import swap in cocos.py, and the imas_alambic.* import rewrites in the moved modules.
item_verdicts.done_when: the fence names a wheel-version-parity build, a clean py3.12 venv import, engine tests, the seven ambix map test modules adding no failures, and ruff; logs/build-engine.log and logs/build-root.log both give 0.1.dev5555+gd97a9302d, logs/clean-venv.log shows import/version/mint-help at EXIT=0 and 16 engine tests passed, logs/ruff.log reads All checks passed, but the seven-module clause is only asserted for four modules -- head-seven.log shows three in-scope modules error at collection.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to move the mint engine into the imas-alambic workspace member with by-name bundle discovery; the diff creates packages/imas-alambic/pyproject.toml, git-mv's the eight engine modules plus machine_maps/schema.yaml, generalises the by-name resolvers onto bundles at packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:182, and retires the mint command at imas_ambix/data/cli.py:56.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 3ae87c26, 4706e533, d97a9302, f78cad45 and every gate log, and states no blockers, but its after_suite command entry carries literal `<wt>` placeholder text rather than absolute paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence lists packages/imas-alambic, pyproject.toml, seven imas_ambix/data modules plus paths/cli/bundle, imas_ambix/cocos.py, schema.yaml, six tests/data modules, tests/test_cocos.py and the evidence fragment; `git diff --stat f1f0a5b0 f78cad45` touches only those paths, so the diff is inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: packages/imas-alambic/tests/test_bundle_discovery.py:63 fails when bundle_for_machine silently returns the first of two bundles, which logs/negative-control.log confirms with DID NOT RAISE, and tests/test_engine_imports.py:26 imports every engine module in the clean venv.
justifications.evidence: logs/clean-venv.log and logs/negative-control.log record the wheel/import and refusal gates with EXIT lines, but head-seven.log shows three of the seven named modules error at collection so that clause of the done-when is unmeasured, and manifest.md:63 records its after_suite command with `<wt>` placeholders.
justifications.fit: the new code follows the surrounding frozen-dataclass and MappingProxyType idiom of machine_map.py, but packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/eddb.py:4 cross-references `imas_alambic.paths.JT60SA_ROOT`, a module the engine does not ship.
justifications.goal_fidelity: packages/imas-alambic/pyproject.toml makes the engine a workspace member with requires-python >=3.12 and a hatch-vcs version rooted at ../.., and machine_map.py:182 discovers bundles by name, exactly the goal's deliverable.
justifications.reuse: machine_map.py:118 generalises the existing resolve_description_store_root/load_packaged_* resolvers in place onto one bundle owner rather than adding a resolver beside them, and a capability search over imas_ambix found no prior bundle-discovery owner to fork.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in `git diff --stat f1f0a5b0 f78cad45` is inside the fence of prompt.txt, and the two new ambix files (imas_ambix/data/bundle.py, bundle.json) are named in that fence.
